claim: On November 20, 2024 Kinesis Data Streams on-demand mode started to scale to support streaming applications that write up to 10GB/s per stream and consumers that read up to 20 GB/s per stream.
question: What was the on-demand write and read throughput limit of a Kinesis data stream before November 2024?

qualifiers.condition: the 10 GB/s limit holds in US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland); other Regions are lower

note: Current truth: kinesis-data-streams-on-demand-max-throughput-regions. Older exam questions may assume 200 MB/s (default) or 2 GB/s (limit before this change).
